description: What this repository's scripts, builds and tests leave behind, for phobos-modkit's cleanup command (python scripts/cleanup.py). Only direct children of each folder that match are ever chosen.

rules.name: Install backups
rules.why: the install deploy.py replaced; the newest of each mod stays

rules.name: .NET build logs
rules.why: a log the .NET tools write at every build; nothing reads them

rules.name: RimWorld crash dumps
rules.why: older dumps of the game's crashes; scripts/crash-dump.py reads the newest, which stays

rules.name: Background clean-up staging
rules.why: textures re-exported by scripts/art/clean_backgrounds.py stage, and their review page; applied or set aside within a week

rules.name: Paint mask staging
rules.why: vehicle bodies re-painted by scripts/art/repaint_vehicles.py stage, and their review page; applied or set aside within a week

rules.name: Art staging on the work drive
rules.why: re-exports staged for review in the art tools' working folder (artWorkPath): applied or set aside within a week; made again on the next run

rules.name: Review cards
rules.why: the owner's picture cards (scripts/art/review_cards.py), drawn again from the real export whenever wanted

rules.name: Frozen game logs
rules.why: copies of Player.log taken before the owner's next launch could overwrite them, for reading verbose logs; read within a fortnight

rules.name: Unpacked archive copies
rules.why: older builds unpacked from the assembly archive for comparing (scripts/assembly-archive.py); the archive keeps every one compressed, so these unpack again when needed
